protocol.context_schedule: A train -> B online adapt -> A retained probe
protocol.event_definition: candidate key equals previous cue key
protocol.candidate_feature_input: raw previous cue one-hot, current key one-hot, value
protocol.event_distractor_marginal_contract: exact per-lane permutation of the same (key,value) multiset
protocol.write_critic_target: exact finite future query-loss gain of candidate write versus no-write
protocol.write_budget: exactly one of two candidates per cue
protocol.inference_projection: straight_through_top1 during training; hard top1 at evaluation
protocol.strong_route_control: learnable sparse permutation on identical factor graph
protocol.route_resource_gate: Givens/sparse-permutation ratio within [1/1.05,1.05] on six axes; shared gate excluded
